scope.test: Seed: Undo and Redo restore and reapply a GPU color change

trigger: Run 34308048377 on c5093b0b98b926e0ef1f19e0b36fa00858bd2fa8 failed at tests/seed.spec.ts:79 after a fixed 150ms wait; the same exact SHA/test/browser/shard passed on run attempt 2.
propagationPath: React settings/history update -> useEffect dependency -> requestAnimationFrame -> WebGL render -> framebuffer -> Playwright canvas screenshot, with no explicit application-level render completion boundary.
violatedInvariant: Browser pixel assertions must observe the framebuffer produced by the committed state, not a time-based approximation of render completion.
responsibleSource: src/tools/seed/index.tsx render scheduling and tests/seed.spec.ts time-based synchronization.
observableSymptom: Chromium FAST shard-2 intermittently compared the post-redo canvas against the earlier edited screenshot and received false equality.
repair: Expose canvas data-render-revision after successful SeedGLEngine.render() and make GPU pixel assertions await a revision change instead of sleeping for a fixed duration.
